events.title: Living Worlds: a whole new Stellar Nursery
events.summary: If the last Stellar Nursery you saw was our September demo, you saw a different game. Since then we have rebuilt nearly all of it: how it looks, how you get around, what the worlds do, and what you hear. The free demo has the new version today, in time for Steam Next Fest, October 19 to 26. P.O.R.T.I.A.'s voice in the new trailer is mine. I recorded it myself. A new lookThe busy panels are gone. events.title: Demo v0.3: less at once, and a lot better to look at
events.summary: The clearest thing people told us about the demo was that there was too much on screen too early. A station console, a tape deck, a puzzle shelf and a panel of systems, all at once, before you had lit anything. So the demo has been rebuilt around the first hour. events.title: Demo v0.2.3: Mac frame rate fixed, and a gentler opening
events.summary: Two days after the big one, a patch. Most of it came from watching people play the last build. Mac players: please try again If you played the demo on a Mac through Steam this past week, it ran at about 20 frames per second, and that was our bug, not your machine. The Steam overlay helper we ship for Windows was also running on Mac, where the overlay has never worked, and it was costing more than half the frame rate. It is off on Mac now. events.title: Demo v0.2: a new opening, worlds lit by their star, and a Windows fix
events.summary: First demo update since August 20, and it is a big one. Here is everything that changed. The opening The game now opens on a Portia Plays studio card, then the title emerges out of black over a living star field. Any click or key skips ahead. First-time players skip the card and go straight into PORTIA's boot sequence. Boot lines animate in properly, and skipping the boot fades instead of cutting. events.title: Cosmetic Layers
events.summary: Idle games have a reputation, and we understood it going in. Numbers go up, you close the tab. We built one anyway, because the part we actually wanted to make was the part nobody expects to find. Here is a full accounting of one of those layers: the 122 ways you can change how Stellar Nursery looks.Planet themes 58A theme here is not a skin on one planet. events.title: The Five Mini Games Inside the Idle Game
events.summary: Someone asked whether the "Deep Invest" button next to a quick action was just a bigger version of the same thing. It is not. Every deep action in the Nurture console opens its own real minigame, and until now the only way to know that was to click one yourself. events.title: All about the UI
events.summary: Every panel in Stellar Nursery is custom. No UI framework, no template. This is a close look at the console.The tape deck is a real tape deck.
